protocol.source_mode: Train data normalization computed on full original training group in each task. Even position sampling independent of label: 48 train, first dev group 12 for selection, last dev group 16 cold validation. Future primary test domains are unopened here. One seed, limited quality development pilot; torch FP64-physics/mixed-learning, N8,T8. Include source attributions from DATA_LICENSES.md.
